title: Protective effects of Ganoderma lucidum spores on estradiol benzoate-induced TEC apoptosis and compromised double-positive thymocyte development

evidence_spans.quote: In this study, a mice model of estradiol benzoate (EB)-induced thymic atrophy was constructed
in mice
Thymic atrophy marks the onset of immune aging
the improvement effect of GLS on thymic atrophy was evaluated
we employs multi-omics techniques

scope_reviewer.uncertainty_reason: The report claims multi-omics but does not name a countable molecular omics domain or assay; V-J rearrangement is not itself sufficient to infer genomics.
scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This is an empirical mouse intervention study targeting thymic atrophy explicitly framed as immune aging. Its generic multi-omics claim leaves the molecular layers unresolved.
